label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Re-engage inactive subscribers
body: Send a specific email to subscribers who haven't opened or clicked recently to see if they still want to hear from you.
caption:
Keeping your email list active and engaged is smart for creators and sellers. Sometimes, subscribers just need a friendly reminder. Before removing those who haven't interacted in a while, try sending a special re-engagement email. It's a chance to offer value, remind them why they joined, and see if their interests have shifted. This helps you maintain a quality audience.
